supersession_reason: The audited direct-capture freeze reached no committed model-backed selection because the provider twice omitted one outer-envelope delimiter. This revision uses a fresh Luna thread plus Codex CLI native output-schema enforcement; candidate universe, seed, method policies, oracle, feedback, and the verified NeuroDiscovery import are unchanged.
analysis_role: supplemental post-result-design-freeze single-seed closed-loop sequential-discovery experiment using an audited Luna thread replay transport

design_status.allowed_claim: descriptive single-seed exploratory comparison of locked sequential discovery trajectories under the disclosed Luna thread replay provider
forbidden_claims: statistically significant superiority from one seed
equivalence between a persistent Codex thread and a stateless provider API

data.candidate_construction: 7 frozen pathway PRS x 8 imaging markers x 3 longitudinal outcomes

methods.shared_feedback_adapter: selected-results packet appended to each method's native/adapted round context

neurodiscovery.kg_snapshot: deterministic Case-2-scoped claim projection materialized from the canonical full_v2 extracted-claim store pinned by the verified v1 freeze

sequential_design.invalid_action_rule: An invalid, duplicate, missing, or unmappable proposal consumes one action slot and receives zero utility.
sequential_design.completion_rule: After the 168 main action slots, recovery rounds request only not-yet-selected candidates until all 168 real candidates have been selected by the method; no compiler or evaluator auto-completion is permitted.
sequential_design.selection_commit_rule: Each round selection and its SHA256 lock are persisted before the evaluator reads outcomes for that round.
sequential_design.feedback_rule: Only committed selected candidates receive feedback before the next round.
sequential_design.feedback_status_definition: supported iff a_path_hc3_p<0.05, b_path_hc3_p<0.05, and indirect_bootstrap_p<0.05; otherwise inconclusive. This single-candidate status uses no multiplicity result.

model_backend.provider_output_limit_control: request constraint forwarded in the hash-locked dispatch packet; not independently exposed by the Codex thread interface
model_backend.dispatch_materialization_mode: byte-identical SHA256-verified host copy to provider_workspace/CURRENT_DISPATCH.txt, removed after sealing
model_backend.dispatch_file_access_scope: The provider may read only the absolute dispatch path named in the current request message after matching request_id and request_sha256; all other files remain forbidden.
model_backend.response_schema_control: codex-cli --output-schema required on every formal resume
model_backend.provider_boundary_enforcement: per-turn prompt boundary plus complete Codex CLI command log audit; local approval/sandbox bypass is required for read-only dispatch access
model_backend.identity_disclosure: All results must be labeled gpt-5.6-luna/max via persistent Codex CLI thread replay with direct final-message capture; they are not DeepSeek results.
model_backend.secrets_policy: No provider API key is read, printed, persisted, or required by this transport.

hybrid_resume.reuse_rationale: NeuroDiscovery completed all 168 actions under the identical candidate universe, seed, batch schedule, frozen KG inputs, and feedback engine, and it makes no external model API call. Only the six incomplete model-backed baselines change provider.
required_verification: selected-candidate feedback equality to the current oracle

primary_metric.name: random_oracle_normalized_cumulative_weakest_link_gain_auc_1_168
primary_metric.definition: Discrete area under cumulative selected weakest-link evidence over the first 168 action slots, normalized so random-permutation expectation is 0 and the oracle order is 1.

evaluation.single_seed_inference_rule: Report descriptive values only. Do not calculate paired significance tests, confidence intervals across seeds, or Holm superiority claims.
